items.title: Online booking
items.text: Customers see your free slots and book in two taps. Opening hours and breaks are taken into account automatically.

items.title: Automatic reminders
items.text: An SMS or WhatsApp message goes out a day and two hours before the appointment, so fewer bookings are forgotten.

items.title: Waiting list
items.text: A cancelled slot is offered to the first customer on the waiting list. If they accept, your calendar fills up again.

items.title: Teams and branches
items.text: Every team member has their own calendar, time off and services. Manage several branches from one screen.

items.title: Deposits and prepayment
items.text: Ask for a small deposit at busy times. Payments go through a secure link and your own cancellation rules apply.

items.title: Simple reports
items.text: See which service, day and team member is busiest on a single page, and export the table to a spreadsheet.
